Method of Attack: Setting up remote desktop connection by creating hidden administrator account
Altering registry keys to enable Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP)
Opening a port to accept incoming RDP connections
Interacting with command and control (C2) server
Stealing collected data and encryption keys
Impacted Systems: Windows systems (excluding those with Russian, Armenian, Azerbaijani, Belarusian, Georgian, Kazakh, Tajik, Turkmen, or Uzbek language settings)
Attack Vector: Remote Desktop Protocol exploitation via created admin account
